about: WhatsApp message templates Trainee uses (WO-038). The owner submits each one in Meta's WhatsApp Manager (Account tools > Message templates > Create template) exactly as written here, then sets the env var to the approved name. Outside WhatsApp's 24-hour window this is the only thing Trainee sends; the full message waits in the outbox and goes out whole when the person replies. Without the env var, messages outside the window wait and nothing is sent. Steps: docs/launch/TRAINEE-GO-LIVE.md, WhatsApp section.

templates.name: trainee_updates

components.text: Trainee has {{1}} new update(s) for you. Reply to see them.

parameters.1: how many messages are waiting for the person (a whole number, at least 1)

templates.why_utility: It tells the person that updates they asked for (job alerts they turned on, their daily report, receipts for applications they approved, applications waiting for their approval) are waiting. It promotes nothing and links nowhere. Meta decides the category and may approve it as MARKETING (rule of 2025-04-09); if it does, per-user marketing limits (131049) apply and the messages still wait for the person's next reply.
